name: n8n Nod
desc: Standalone personal agent from n8n Labs that runs on your computer.
desc_zh: n8n Labs 出品、运行在你电脑上的独立个人智能体。
solves: Work that spans several apps and sites never fits one workflow; an agent that drives the apps directly finishes the task.
solves_zh: 跨多个应用和网站的活很难塞进一条工作流；能直接操作应用的智能体才能把事做完。
best_for: You want one assistant that works inside your apps and asks before it acts.
best_for_zh: 你想要一个能在你的应用里干活、并且行动前先问你的助手。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — n8n.io/blog）。 Blog post by Ophir Prusak, November 10, 2026, described as a research preview from n8n Labs. A standalone desktop product separate from the n8n workflow platform the ledger holds. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Nod」，卡片上认不出属于谁，带上厂商名。 首次公开日期来源：https://n8n.io/blog/meet-nod/
